(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (rect-border r0 c0 r1 c1)
      (filter (lambda (p)
                (or (= (first p) r0) (= (first p) r1)
                    (= (second p) c0) (= (second p) c1)))
              (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1)))
    (define (hollow-rect? obj)
      (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj)))
        (and (>= (- (third bb) (first bb)) 2)
             (>= (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 2)
             (equal? (sort (obj-cells obj) cell<?)
                     (sort (rect-border (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)) cell<?)))))
    (define frames
      (sort (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 4) (hollow-rect? o))) (objects g 0))
            (lambda (a b)
              (> (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b))))))
    (define k (length (find-color g 2)))
    (if (and (>= k 1) (<= k (length frames)))
        (paint-cells g (obj-cells (list-ref frames (- k 1))) 8)
        g)))

(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (cell<? a b)
      (or (< (first a) (first b))
          (and (= (first a) (first b)) (< (second a) (second b)))))
    (define (rect-border r0 c0 r1 c1)
      (filter (lambda (p)
                (or (= (first p) r0) (= (first p) r1)
                    (= (second p) c0) (= (second p) c1)))
              (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1)))
    (define (hollow-rect? obj)
      (let ((bb (obj-bbox obj)))
        (and (>= (- (third bb) (first bb)) 2)
             (>= (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 2)
             (equal? (sort (obj-cells obj) cell<?)
                     (sort (rect-border (first bb) (second bb) (third bb) (fourth bb)) cell<?)))))
    (define (strict-center-cross obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (r0 (first bb)) (c0 (second bb))
             (r1 (third bb)) (c1 (fourth bb))
             (mr (quotient (+ r0 r1) 2))
             (mc (quotient (+ c0 c1) 2)))
        (filter (lambda (p)
                  (let ((r (first p)) (c (second p)))
                    (and (> r r0) (< r r1) (> c c0) (< c c1)
                         (or (= r mr) (= c mc)))))
                (positions-in-rect r0 c0 r1 c1))))
    (define frames
      (sort (filter (lambda (o) (and (= (obj-color o) 4) (hollow-rect? o))) (objects g 0))
            (lambda (a b)
              (> (* (obj-h a) (obj-w a)) (* (obj-h b) (obj-w b))))))
    (define k (length (find-color g 2)))
    (if (and (>= k 1) (<= k (length frames)))
        (let* ((selected (list-ref frames (- k 1)))
               (bordered (paint-cells g (obj-cells selected) 8)))
          (paint-cells bordered (strict-center-cross selected) 9))
        g)))
